ContradictionsList.title: Hints
ContradictionsList.info:
What does the AI do?

The AI checks the documents for contradictions. The plausibility check evaluates text-based content only. Content from figures, plans, or tables is currently not analyzed systematically.

Contradictions are checked within each individual document. In addition, each individual document is compared against the explanatory report whenever the AI has identified a document as the explanatory report. Contradictions between two documents of which neither is identified as the explanatory report are not checked.

The professional assessment of the displayed hints and the decision on how to proceed always remain with the users.

emptyState.noHintsDescription: No contradictions were detected in the documents.

ContradictionsToolbar.ratingInfo:
Use the slider to define the sensitivity threshold from which hints are shown. You can choose between “low sensitivity” (left) and “high sensitivity” (right).

Low sensitivity: Shows all available contradictions. This may also include less contradictory hints.

High sensitivity: Shows only hints for more contradictory text passages. This may potentially hide contradictions considered relevant.

Important: All hints remain available and must be reviewed. Hints that have already been processed are marked accordingly.
